deliverables.title: Labs (Best 7 of 11)
deliverables.notes: 11 labs total, each worth 1%; best 7 count. Lab weeks: Sept 15–19, Sept 22–26, Sept 29–Oct 3, Oct 6–10, Oct 13–17, Oct 20–24, Oct 27–31, Nov 10–14, Nov 17–21, Nov 24–28, Dec 1–5. No labs on non-instructional days (Sept 30, Oct 13); alternatives will be provided. Must attend registered lab section, arrive on time, and actively participate.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Labs occur during a week window with no single fixed weekday; exact day depends on each student's registered lab section.

deliverables.title: Quiz 1
deliverables.notes: In-class, on paper, closed book. 30 minutes. No electronics allowed. Held during Thursday class time instead of office hours. No make-up quizzes; if missed, weight moves to other quiz.

deliverables.title: Quiz 2
deliverables.notes: In-class, on paper, closed book. 30 minutes. No electronics allowed. Held during Thursday class time instead of office hours. No make-up quizzes; if missed, weight moves to other quiz.

deliverables.title: Participation (iClicker / ZyBooks)
deliverables.notes: 1% per week; best 10 of 11–12 weeks count. Earned via iClicker attendance/participation in Tuesday lectures OR completing assigned ZyBooks activities (Participation + Challenge Activities). Only one option needed per week to earn the mark, but both options available.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: No single fixed due date per week; participation is earned through ongoing weekly activities across two possible channels.

deliverables.title: Final Exam
deliverables.notes: Scheduled by the university during the exam period (December 11–22, 2025). Cumulative, closed book, 3 hours. Exact date/time/location to be announced in November. No make-up for avoidable travel conflicts.
deliverables.ambiguity_reason: Exact date, time, and location not yet determined at time of syllabus publication; falls somewhere in Dec 11–22, 2025.
